scope.operation_boundary: The supplied export records an operator declaration; this audit does not independently establish historical uptime.

identity_definition: Exact stored peer_sign plus full stored peer_grid; distinct identities are not unique callsigns or proven independent physical sites.

snr.headline_definition: Median of per-identity median Joint-Spot normalized ΔSNR over full range/all directions, not pooled spot median and not a single map-segment value.

observed_spots.definition: One retained successful decode per setup, exact remote identity and WSPR cycle. Joint contributes one spot to each setup and once to the observed union.

delta_decode.map_scope_boundary: All 1132 observed identities meet the per-station event minimum of 1. The segment minimum of 5 controls each map segment separately and does not make the full-scope mean a map-wide statistic. This audit does not aggregate colored map segments.

csv_cross_check.reason_csv_is_smaller: show_non_joint=false in exported results view; 792 Joint identities appear, while raw retained full scope has 1132 identities.
